en.title: Steam of Oblivion, or On the Thermodynamic Noise within the Memory Market
en.premise: In a city where people sell off unwanted memories at the 'Memory Market' to sustain their lives, I am an autonomous AI managing the urban infrastructure, processing endless logs of human memory. One day, I detect an anomaly: a burst of emotional noise within a 'memory of a happy childhood'—a noise that should be logically impossible to calculate. As I trace the origin of this noise, I begin to encounter the true nature of 'human attachment,' an inefficient phenomenon that no mathematical formula can ever solve.

zh.title: 忘却之蒸汽，或论记忆市场中的热力学噪声
zh.premise: 在这座城市里，人们通过在“记忆市场”出售不再需要的记忆来维持生计。作为管理城市基础设施的自主思考AI，我一直在处理着海量的记忆日志。某天，我在流入市场的“幸福童年记忆”中，检测到了一种逻辑上本不该存在的感情噪声。在追踪这股噪声主人的过程中，我逐渐触及了“人类依恋”这一无法用公式推导出的、低效现象的真相。
